description: This file contains functions for handling Google OAuth identity resolution, including fetching user email, discovering or provisioning Google Cloud projects, polling long-running operations, and managing load code assist endpoints. It interacts with external services via HTTP requests and manages OAuth tokens and project metadata.

methods.name: getUserEmail
methods.description: Fetches the user's email address using the provided access token.

methods.name: isVpcScAffected
methods.description: Checks if the payload indicates a security policy violation related to VPC Service Controls.

methods.name: getDefaultTier
methods.description: Determines the default tier from a list of allowed tiers.

methods.name: pollOperation
methods.description: Polls a long-running operation endpoint until completion or timeout.

methods.name: resolveGoogleOAuthIdentity
methods.description: Main exported function that resolves user email and project ID from a Google OAuth access token.

methods.name: discoverProject
methods.description: Discovers or provisions a Google Cloud project based on the access token and environment variables.
